description: For Individuals and HUFs not having income from profits and gains of business or profession. Suitable for those with multiple house properties, capital gains, or foreign assets/income.

fields.name: PAN Number
fields.description: 10-digit valid Permanent Account Number. Must be linked to Aadhaar.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Select whether filing as Individual or Hindu Undivided Family (HUF).

fields.name: Salary Schedule (Schedule S)
fields.description: Detail gross salary, allowances, and perquisites as per Form 16.

fields.name: Income from House Property (Schedule HP)
fields.description: Details of rental income, municipal taxes, and interest on housing loans for multiple properties.

fields.name: Capital Gains (Schedule CG)
fields.description: Short-term/Long-term gains from sale of property, shares, mutual funds, or virtual digital assets (crypto).

fields.name: Income from Other Sources (Schedule OS)
fields.description: Includes interest from saving/FDs, dividend income, and winnings from lotteries.

fields.name: Current Year Losses & Set-off (Schedule CYLA)
fields.description: Adjusting losses from one source against income from another source within the same year.

fields.name: Schedule FA (Foreign Assets)
fields.description: Mandatory for resident Indians having any foreign bank accounts or assets outside India.

fields.name: TDS / TCS / Advance Tax Paid (Schedule TI)
fields.description: Verification of taxes already deducted/collected and deposited against PAN.

fields.name: Bank Account Details
fields.description: All operative bank accounts held in India at any time during the previous year for refund processing.
